# Braintrust

> > Braintrust is a user-owned talent network connecting companies with top technical freelancers, powered by the BTRST token on Ethereum for decentralized governance.

Braintrust operates as a Web3 talent marketplace that removes traditional platform fees by giving ownership to its community through blockchain technology. The platform offers free job boards, 48-hour talent matching, and extensive hiring resources across technical, creative, and business roles.

## Key Topics

- BTRST token
- Talent marketplace
- Web3 and decentralized governance
- Freelance platform
- 48-hour talent matching
- Free job boards
- Blockchain technology
- User ownership model
- Technical hiring
- Job description templates
- Interview questions
- Ethereum mainnet
- Zero-fee platform
- Community-driven network
- Braintrust Technology Foundation
